messages.content: Based on the tasks and my current status, I want to write an email. Whom should I wite to and what should be the content.

### Who to email
Given your scheduled task **“2026-05-22 | Open: Call the broker”**, the most appropriate recipient is **your assigned broker/contact** (i.e., the broker handling your submission for cyber insurance).  
If you have an underwriter contact on the policy/submission, you can **cc** them, but the primary addressee should be the broker.

---

### Email content (copy/paste draft)

**Subject:** Cyber Insurance Submission – Follow-up / Call Request (May 22)

Hi [Broker Name],  
I hope you’re doing well. I’m following up on the cyber insurance submission and would like to connect via a quick call.

**Proposed time:** [insert time window]  
**Agenda:**  
1) Confirm any outstanding information/documents needed for underwriting review  
2) Review current status and next steps  
3) Discuss timelines/any required evidence

If another time works better, please share your availability and I’ll adjust.  

Thank you,  
[Your Name]  
[Title / Company]  
[Phone] | [Email]

---

### Quick question (so I can tailor it)
Do you know the broker’s name/email and your preferred call time window? If you share those, I’ll customize the subject line and agenda to match your exact situation.
No, please search the submission information for the broker information and re-write the email

**Subject:** Cyber Insurance Submission – Status Follow-up / Call Request (May 22)

Hi Evan,  
I hope you’re doing well. I’m reaching out to follow up on our cyber insurance submission and to confirm what’s still needed on your side before underwriting can move forward.

Would you be available for a quick call on **May 22**?  
**Suggested time:** [insert time window].  
If that doesn’t work, please share a time that’s convenient and I’ll adjust.

Thank you,  
[Your Name]  
[Title] | [Company]  
[Phone] | [Email]

**Optional CC (if appropriate):** Priya Raman (priya.raman@midwestcommercial.example)
